intervals.label: PLUTO data taking (DORIS and PETRA)
intervals.locator: Ziemann (DORIS start); Bethke & Wagner (2022), section 2 (replacement by CELLO in March 1980)
intervals.note: Union of the two phases. PLUTO is recorded as ending in March 1980 when CELLO replaced it at PETRA; whether PLUTO took data elsewhere later (for example back at DORIS) is not stated in the sources fetched.
intervals.quote: Towards the end of 1974, the two detectors PLUTO and DASP were placed in their respective collision points.

intervals.label: PLUTO removed from PETRA; replaced by CELLO
intervals.note: End of PLUTO at PETRA; later activity of the detector, if any, is not sourced here.
intervals.quote: PLUTO had already operated [32] at the precursor storage ring DORIS, and was replaced at PETRA in March 1980 by the newly built CELLO detector [33].

placements.note: DORIS period; campus-grade marker. The end is bounded by the October 1978 move into the PETRA beam; the exact date PLUTO left DORIS is not stated.
placements.quote: Towards the end of 1974, the two detectors PLUTO and DASP were placed in their respective collision points.

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: DESY published no coordinates for the PETRA experimental halls that were fetched; the marker is the DESY campus point.
placements.quote: Mark-J, PLUTO, TASSO detectors moved into beam

summary.plain: The PLUTO particle detector, moved from DESY's DORIS ring to a PETRA collision region in 1978.
summary.technical: PLUTO detector: placed at a DORIS collision point at the end of 1974; moved into the PETRA beam in October 1978; replaced at PETRA by CELLO in March 1980. A published detector description was not retrieved for this record.
